Title: Announcing the new Azure Container Registry libraries

Body.Content: We’re pleased to announce that version 1.1.0 of the Azure Container Registry (ACR) libraries for .NET, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python are now generally available. A Go library is currently available as a preview; the stable release is expected later this year. Visit the Azure SDK blog for more details
